rules.rule:
Add one compiler-generated content row/capability for the full Invite producer/consumer bundle; preserve all20 current payloads, dependency pins and migrations1..37. Policies are versioned reconstruction choices with exact src_64 provenance. API readiness validates schema, target ports, existing qualified Gift/Relation presentation and new codec/consumer composition before enabling type10 production. With an older active catalog, preserve its pointer and legacy unprojected core Invite behavior; type10 providers/producers remain inactive and no historical backfill occurs. Explicit deploy prepares/installs the exact complete compatible content before CAS activation. Neither API nor worker migrates or activates on startup.

Extend the existing Guild single-owner River worker, finite physical guild_materialization queue, DispatchRegistry and the one ReconcileKernel. Add only fixed issue/marker/reconcile routes and strict reference codecs. Keep8A routes, owner session key, four workers,30s budget,45s timeout,15soft retry and joined health/drain semantics. No new process-owner key, fourth bus, generic dispatcher, value from job payload or separate scheduler. Pending scans enqueue/schedule atomically under owner locks; terminal state is not reset.

Populated accepted37→38 upgrade must preserve every existing row/sequence/content pointer and add nullable bindings without updates/backfill. New tables begin empty. Joint restore includes Guild roots/invites/events/cursors/source issues/markers/ACK progress, Social roots/notices/target proof/dismissal, Foundation receipts, active and historical content, retained I4 allocators, I5/Mail/Gift/Friend/General facts and River scheduling state. Missing jobs can be recovered from canonical pending; missing canonical proof remains a conflict. Restore tests cover pending materialization/partial cleanup/old terminal notices and a second restart, with no resurrection or duplicate entitlement.

Materializer reloads an exact canonical issue reference and compatible immutable historical policy. Fresh target transaction takes recipient315, reads typed Guild snapshot without retaining a Guild lock, prepares SocialRoot360 presence/absence, target receipt/Notice370 typed source creation fence and then mutates. Root creation must use a prepared additive owner port without a post-mutation lock; the existing EnsureRootTx (insert then lock) is not an acceptable new plan shortcut. Hold no Guild source locks while committing this target command.

Fresh eligibility requires the bound current generation/issue, active same-server Guild, strict unexpired issue, no current recipient membership and no later JOIN boundary. Corrupt/missing canonical Guild facts are errors, not ineligibility. Expired, superseded, honestly retired or later-JOIN issues can produce an explicit terminal SUPPRESSED receipt without a Notice. Recipient absence requires the qualified I4 allocator-backed absence proof; database error or rollback cursor hole is never Gone. Deleted inviter is presentation-hidden; retain the issue and any existing target/Notice/tombstone. No Gift/Mail/economy mutation is performed.

Eligible first materialization allocates a wire-safe Notice ID and inserts type10 with source tuple, immutable issue-time NoticeTime, numeric inviter binding and root/target proof atomically. Replays validate the immutable Notice fields and target receipt, preserve dismissed/tombstone state and do not allocate another ID. Notice present without the complete target receipt, or a receipt requiring a Notice that is missing, is a conflict; no healing/recreation. Historical target proof remains positive after related inviter deletion or recipient deletion, as specified by retained terminal evidence. Source ACK commits separately and only after matching the typed target proof and rechecking the source binding; target crash before ACK leaves source Pending.

Cleanup marker work reads a bounded next page (default32, finite maximum1000) of issue serials <= source high-water and exact JOIN/retirement predicate. For each issue, a separate SocialInbox command validates immutable marker/issue references and prepares recipient315→SocialRoot360→matchingNotice370. Existing matching type10 is consumed monotonically, preserving source uniqueness and receipt/Notice identity. No Notice is created by cleanup. Target invalidation proof binds marker ID/fingerprint, issue tuple/fingerprint, recipient and resulting exact Notice state or legitimate terminal absence. No-op repeats retain their first receipt; other-owner notices cannot be consumed.

Only after target proof commits does a separate Guild ACK transaction advance marker cursor past that exact page. Crash before cursor ACK repeats the same finite page through idempotent target proof. Partial page failure cannot skip the failing issue. Maximum source serial and immutable query predicate ensure new issues cannot be consumed by older markers. Each page schedules bounded continuation; exhaustion marks marker terminal. JOIN targeting an issue not yet materialized is safe: the materializer's canonical guard suppresses it; cleanup does not invent a target Notice. Reconciliation restores missing scheduling work from canonical Pending issues/markers only and never revisits terminal sources or historical legacy facts.
